business: PI Industries is a life sciences company originating from India. It develops and manufactures crop protection products, biologicals, pharma CRDMO services, and specialty chemicals. It serves global agricultural and pharmaceutical markets through innovation-led solutions.

segments.name: Crop Protection & Biologicals
segments.comment: Core agri-sciences business including insecticides and plant health solutions

segments.name: Pharma CRDMO
segments.comment: Contract research, development and manufacturing services for pharmaceuticals

revenue_mix: Global operations: India, US, LATAM, Mexico, UK. Products span crop protection, biologicals, pharma services, specialty chemicals. Specific geographic/product percentages not disclosed.
strategy: Innovation-led growth: originate molecules in India for global markets
Advance proprietary pipeline including new chemical entities (NCE)
Scale pharma CRDMO platform for contract services expansion
Build biologicals platform for sustainable crop protection solutions
Diversify into electronic chemicals and specialty segments
outlook: Entering 80th year focused on pioneering innovation in life sciences from India to world. Plans to take new active ingredients to global markets, scale pharma services platform, and expand across sectors creating multiple growth pathways.
risks: Geopolitical realignments and shifting trade dynamics affecting supply chain
Climate variability and changing weather patterns impacting agricultural demand
Increasing regulatory scrutiny on agrochemicals and life sciences products
Supply chain resilience and diversification requirements in volatile markets
